skill.summary: German-speaking content creators edit raw video footage into edited German videos using this skill. Accepts MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB, renders on cloud...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Editor AI Deutsch for AI-assisted video editing in German.
- Supports raw video uploads (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and cloud rendering at 1080p with quick turnaround.
- Simple onboarding: automatic backend connection and token setup for new users.
- Workflow includes file upload, editing via prompts (including German instruction support), export/download, status, and credit checks.
- Comprehensive error handling and session management for a smooth editing experience.
- Designed for German-speaking content creators; optimized for short and iterative edits.
